Here are two recent transfers, one from JK ruby (girl) one from Geola yag.

Just proofs, visible flaws in each... Casual photography, but you get the idea!

Portrait of cat and girl is unshifted playback color, other is shifted several hundred nm with TEA preswell.

Masters shot at Fourth Dimension Holographics and HoloCenter, respectively. Transferred at Holocenter using red and green diodes I recently picked up.

Unfortunately, my current building is vibration central but if I can find a better location you will see more work...

Mike F
